## Goal

All library errors must be returned through non-throwing explicit result/error values, including syntax, conversion/access, allocation and limit failures. This applies even when the consuming project enables exceptions.

Define reviewed C++17 public API contracts and types for explicit bytes/length, syntax defaults, results, ownership, exact numbers, errors and allocation before a developer implements the production reader. Agent work is documentation and planned GoogleTest cases only; production C++ belongs to the developer.

## Requirements

`J5-001`, `J5-003`, `J5-004`, `J5-005`, `J5-008` — [active requirements](https://github.com/Romanr92/Adaptive_JSON5/blob/main/docs/requirements.md).

Status: Draft. Issue creation does not approve or verify these contracts.

## Prerequisites

None. Start here; settle public behavior before dependent implementation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Public headers use portable standard C++17 and expose no AdaptivePi, WSL, host-tool or editor types.
  - Reviewed 2026-10-13 for the current `error.hpp` and `result.hpp` inventory: standard-library dependencies only; each header independently compiles as the first/only include with Windows/GCC 15.2.0, C++17, `-pedantic-errors`, RTTI OFF and exceptions OFF/ON. Review future declarations against the same boundary. This does not declare full J5-001 platform-matrix or embedded-runtime verification.
- [ ] Document exact-length/read-only/non-NUL-terminated input semantics and mode/result defaults; add API/configuration GoogleTest cases as the corresponding declarations become available. Complete parse behavior is verified by subsequent grammar issues.
- [x] Specify equivalent recoverable outcomes in exception OFF/ON builds and prohibit invalid-input assert/abort/throw; complete runtime cases land with the implemented reader.
  - Specified 2026-10-13 in the local `docs/architecture.md` recoverable-error contract: explicit category mapping, equivalent compiler-mode behavior, allocation-free minimal reporting, checked access and atomic failure/cleanup. P002 has local result-container evidence; parser, conversion/access, allocation-exhaustion and resource-limit runtime verification remain pending. Documentation changes await the repository commit.
- [ ] Document syntax defaults, ownership/views, duplicate policy, conversions, error categories, limits and thread-safety; unresolved choices remain Draft.

## Notes

Compatible C++17 projects are the supported goal; do not promise every historical C++ implementation.
